steps.title: Meet Captain Pip
steps.goal: Talk to Captain Pip in the middle of Sky Dock.

steps.title: Breezy Run
steps.goal: Wake Breezy Run and find the Breeze Charm.

steps.title: Rope Loft
steps.goal: Wake Rope Loft with your Breeze Charm and find the Rope Charm.

steps.title: Vane Valley
steps.goal: Wake Vane Valley with your Rope Charm and find the Vane Charm.

steps.title: Crate Cove
steps.goal: Wake Crate Cove with your Vane Charm and find the Crate Charm.

steps.title: Foghorn Reef
steps.goal: Wake Foghorn Reef with your Crate Charm and find the Foghorn Charm.

steps.title: The Tangled Bell
steps.goal: Wake The Tangled Bell with your Foghorn Charm and find the Bell Charm.

steps.title: Back to the Dock
steps.goal: Tell Captain Pip that the Dock Bell sings again.
